name: Sant Boi de Llobregat (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white pile issuing from the fly whose point reaches the hoist, the pile bearing a smaller red pile at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Sant Boi de Llobregat; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: pile from the fly edge to the hoist
smaller pile within the white pile
